reference_contract.original_precision: Original FP64 full layer reported separately; not silently claimed by quantized-domain success
reference_contract.handoff: Actual attention GPU output supplies FFN pack AND FFN residual without host reconstruction
reference_contract.immutable: All weights, parameters, code, caller input; saved attention output readonly throughout FFN
reference_contract.repeat: Token-permuted normalized inputs; recompute every independent reference for each input
